name: Shrinking Header
description: A full-width header that draws in to a floating glass pill once the page starts to scroll.

props.name: logo
props.description: The brand at the left end, usually a link home.

props.name: items
props.type: { name: string; href: string; current?: boolean }[]
props.description: The links, centred in the bar. The current one gets aria-current="page" and a water dot.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons or links at the right end. Below 1024 pixels they move into the menu panel and share its width.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Scroll distance in pixels after which the bar draws in to a pill.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the sticky header element. Also accepts every other header attribute.
